criteria.text:
Given a repo whose config sets no commissaire.governor
When `faff run open --mode full --root R --session-id S --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with governance "admitted" and steps.poller "ok"
And the new run ledger has owner.status "running", an owner.harness value and budget.measure_root equal to R
criteria.exercised: faff run open --mode full --root /tmp/eval/s1 --session-id sess-s1 --json (fresh git repo, no .faff/config.yaml, commissaire.governor unset: config get exit 3); then read run-ledger.json
criteria.expected: exit 0, governance "admitted", steps.poller "ok"; ledger owner.status "running", owner.harness set, budget.measure_root == /tmp/eval/s1
criteria.observed: exit 0; governance "admitted"; steps.poller "ok"; ledger owner.status "running", owner.harness "claude-code", budget.measure_root "/tmp/eval/s1"

criteria.text:
Given a repo whose config sets commissaire.governor to an endpoint nothing listens on
When `faff run open --mode full --root R --session-id S --json` runs
Then it exits 3 with governance "fail-closed"
And the ledger shows owner.status "done" and stop_reason "governance-admit-failed"
And <run_dir>/commissaire/governance-required.json exists
And `faff sentry-poller status --run-dir <run_dir> --json` prints running false with no pid
criteria.exercised: repo with .faff/config.yaml commissaire.governor: 127.0.0.1:9 (config get prints it); faff run open --mode full --root /tmp/eval/s2 --session-id sess-s2 --json; read ledger; cat <run_dir>/commissaire/governance-required.json; faff sentry-poller status --run-dir <run_dir> --json
criteria.expected: exit 3, governance "fail-closed"; owner.status "done", stop_reason "governance-admit-failed"; governance-required.json exists; poller status running false with no pid
criteria.observed: exit 3; governance "fail-closed", fail_closed_cause "governor-unreachable", steps.poller "skipped"; ledger owner.status "done", stop_reason "governance-admit-failed"; governance-required.json = {"governance_required":true,"governor":"127.0.0.1:9"}; poller status {"running":false}

criteria.text:
Given a run D opened by `faff run open --mode full --max 5` that exited 0, and FAFF_RUN_DIR set to D
When `faff run open --adopt-run-dir D --root R --session-id S --json` runs, and then again with --max 9
Then the first exits 0 with governance "already-governed" and the second exits 2
And the ledger's budget envelope still has max_attempts 5
criteria.exercised: out=$(faff run open --mode full --max 5 --root R --session-id S --export); rc=$?; eval "$out" (rc 0, FAFF_RUN_DIR=D); faff run open --adopt-run-dir D --root R --session-id S --json; then same with --max 9; read budget.envelope.ceilings
criteria.expected: first adopt exit 0 governance "already-governed"; second exit 2; envelope max_attempts 5
criteria.observed: adopt 1: exit 0, governance "already-governed"; adopt 2: exit 2, fault "budget envelope already set: max_attempts 9 differs from the recorded 5"; ceilings.max_attempts 5; ledger byte-identical across adopt 2

criteria.text:
Given `faff run open --mode full --until 25:99 --root R --session-id S`
When it runs
Then it exits 2
And no new directory exists under R/.faff/runs
criteria.exercised: fresh repo (no .faff); faff run open --mode full --until 25:99 --root /tmp/eval/s4 --session-id sess-s4 (also with --json, and again with a pre-existing .faff/runs/run-preexisting)
criteria.expected: exit 2; no new directory under R/.faff/runs
criteria.observed: exit 2, stderr 'until "25:99" is not a valid HH:MM'; R/.faff/runs absent; with a pre-existing runs dir it still holds only run-preexisting

criteria.text:
Given a run ledger with admitted ["A","B"] and outcomes {"A":"shipped"}
When `faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason queue-drained --json` runs
Then it exits 3 with undispatched ["B"]
And run-ledger.json and events.jsonl are byte-identical to before
criteria.exercised: run minted by faff run open, poller stopped, ledger set to admitted [A,B], outcomes {A:shipped}; sha256 of run-ledger.json and events.jsonl; faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason queue-drained --json; sha256sum -c
criteria.expected: exit 3 with undispatched ["B"]; ledger and events byte-identical
criteria.observed: exit 3; closed false, undispatched ["B"], every step skipped; sha256sum -c: run-ledger.json OK, events.jsonl OK

criteria.text:
Given a run ledger with admitted ["A","B"], outcomes {"A":"shipped"}, an abort entry with status "aborted-resumable" and owner.status "aborted-resumable"
When `faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason sentry-abort --json` runs
Then it exits 0 with undispatched ["B"]
And the ledger's stop_reason is "sentry-abort", owner.status is still "aborted-resumable" and outcomes has no entry for "B"
And events.jsonl contains a run-end event with data.stop_reason "sentry-abort"
criteria.exercised: run minted by faff run open, ledger admitted [A,B] outcomes {A:shipped}; faff sentry abort --run-dir D (writes abort.status and owner.status aborted-resumable); faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason sentry-abort --json; read ledger; grep run-end events.jsonl
criteria.expected: exit 0 undispatched ["B"]; stop_reason "sentry-abort"; owner.status "aborted-resumable"; no outcomes B; run-end event with data.stop_reason "sentry-abort"
criteria.observed: exit 0; undispatched ["B"], abort_exempt true, owner_status "aborted-resumable"; ledger stop_reason "sentry-abort", owner.status "aborted-resumable", outcomes {"A":"shipped"}; events.jsonl run-end data.stop_reason "sentry-abort" (shipped 1, parked 0); faff events validate OK

criteria.text:
Given a run ledger with every admitted issue terminal
When `faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason queue-drianed` runs
Then it exits 2 and run-ledger.json is unchanged
criteria.exercised: run minted by faff run open, ledger admitted [A,B] outcomes {A:shipped,B:parked}; sha256; faff run close --run-dir D --stop-reason queue-drianed; sha256sum -c
criteria.observed: exit 2, stderr 'unknown stop reason "queue-drianed"'; run-ledger.json OK (and events.jsonl OK); control: queue-drained then exits 0

criteria.text:
Given a run D whose owner.status is "running" and FAFF_RUN_DIR is unset
When `faff run open --adopt-run-dir D --root R --session-id S` runs
Then it exits 2
And run-ledger.json is byte-identical to before
criteria.exercised: run minted by faff run open (owner.status running), FAFF_RUN_DIR unset; sha256; faff run open --adopt-run-dir D --root R --session-id S; sha256sum -c
criteria.observed: exit 2, stderr 'adopt refused: $FAFF_RUN_DIR does not name this run'; run-ledger.json OK (events.jsonl OK); same with FAFF_RUN_DIR naming another dir; control with FAFF_RUN_DIR=D exits 0
